outputs.explanation: Panel A is a spatial micrograph showing cluster classification overlaid on tissue, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows H&E micrographs with manual region annotations, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C shows H&E and spatial gene expression micrographs, not a plot of averaged data requiring individual points.
Panel D consists of GSEA enrichment line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.

Panel E is a bar graph of log2 fold change values derived from differential gene expression testing (Seurat FindMarkers, Wilcoxon test) between two spot classes; each bar represents a single computed fold-change statistic per gene rather than a mean across replicates, so there are no individual replicate data points to overlay.
